author: Kevin Stratvert
description:
Learn how to use vidIQ for YouTube in this step-by-step beginner tutorial. I'll show you how to connect your channel, find video ideas with AI Coach, research keywords and search demand, spot outlier videos, and improve your titles, thumbnails, and descriptions. We'll also explore the vidIQ browser extension and connect vidIQ to ChatGPT to analyze your channel and identify opportunities to improve.

Host: Kevin Stratvert
